ui.noImpact: Task rows and cards replace the visible Personal or Shared word with a person or group icon while retaining the workspace name and the existing localized tooltip and screen-reader context. Task behavior, permissions, settings and documented workflows are unchanged.

release.note: Prepare alpha.12 and Android code12 with the retained signing identity and unchanged protected documentation epoch.

configuration.note: Document the 32-character production authentication secret requirement, maintenance-only BETTER_AUTH_SECRET_NEXT rotation, and the required pre-existing writable filesystem attachment directory.

deployment.noImpact: The all-in-one image pins zlib 1.3.2-r1 because Alpine removed r0 from its mirrors. Same zlib upstream version and package set; configuration, deployment steps and documented behavior are unchanged.

native.note: Document native export source labels and upload times, separate system save dialogs, retained prepared files after cancellation or save failure, and Saved only after a confirmed write.

authentication.note: Production startup validates secret length and retained JWKS decryption. The authentication guide links the stopped-replica secret rotation procedure instead of direct replacement.

compatibility.note: The storage startup probe and sanitized upload diagnostics do not change persisted attachment formats; restore guidance now covers directory permissions and matching authentication secrets.
compatibility.upgrade: Before upgrading, provision the filesystem directory when attachments are enabled and retain the existing authentication secret.
compatibility.backup: Back up the database, attachment ciphertext, field keys, and authentication secret as a matching recovery set.
compatibility.rollback: Restore matching database and secret backups or reverse authentication-secret rotation while all replicas are stopped.
compatibility.clientVersions: Browser and native clients remain compatible; attachment formats, quotas, permissions, and transfer payloads are unchanged.
